translations: Except If Allah wills Allah wills And remember
your Lord when you forget and say
Perhaps [that] will guide me my Lord
to a nearer (way) than this right way
puzzle.hint: A famous du'a from Surah Al-Kahf where Prophet Musa (AS) supplicates to Allah for relief and ease
puzzle.arabic: إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَـٰذَا رَشَدًۭا
puzzle.verseEn: Except [when adding], "If Allāh wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."
